normalize_img: normalize a PyTorch image tensor using ImageNet mean and std to approx [-1,1]
unnormalize_img: unnormalize a PyTorch image tensor back to [0,1] range from ImageNet normalization
round_pixel: round pixel values of a normalized image tensor to nearest integer and re-normalize
project_linf: clamp the difference between two image tensors to a given L-infinity radius in pixel space
psnr: compute the peak signal-to-noise ratio between two normalized image tensors
